sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美西语近岸软件研发外包与数字客服中心

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Digital Webtoon Publishing and Multilingual Chapter Unlocking

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law 526 of 1999 (creating the Financial Information and Analysis Unit – UIAF); Law 1474 of 2011 (Anti-Corruption Statute); Law 1762 of 2015 (AML/CFT amendments to Criminal Code); Decree 1068 of 2015; DIAN Resolution 000071 of 2022 (Final Beneficiary Reporting); Chamber of Commerce Unified Rules under Cámara de Comercio; Code of Commerce Articles 98-104, 349-380 (S.A.S. rules).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney for Incorporation of S.A.S. (by non-resident founders)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public of the country of origin certified by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs or equivalent competent authority

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Authenticated copy of passport of each shareholder and beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National authority or notary public of the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation (for corporate shareholders)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry or local chamber of commerce of the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and source of funds declaration for capital contribution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Deposit-taking financial institution and signatory shareholder

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory PEP, OFAC SDN, UN consolidated list, EU consolidated list, and Colombian domestic sanctions screening through UIAF and DIAN databases. Enhanced due diligence mandated for PEPs, high-risk jurisdictions, and transactions involving legal persons with layers of ownership. Risk-based approach required under Law 526 of 1999 and UIAF Circular 029 of 2014; for a low-risk digital webtoon entity, baseline KYC and source-of-funds verification for capital contributors apply.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) via Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá VirtualQ / Sistema de Matrícula Virtual
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be expressed in Spanish or in terms deemed easily pronounceable in Spanish; transliteration into Latin alphabet required where the name originates from a non-Roman script. The S.A.S. denomination must appear in the corporate name. Names may not include trade marks, misleading terms, or expressions contrary to law or public policy.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection of a proposed company name, the applicant may file a reconsideration (recurso de reposición) with the same Cámara de Comercio within five (5) business days, and subsequently an appeal (recurso de apelación) before the Superintendencia de Sociedades within ten (10) business days. The appeal must be filed through the RUES portal or by written petition with supporting grounds.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office services are legally permissible for S.A.S. entities, particularly for digital publishing businesses; however, a physical address in Colombia is always required for receiving service of process and regulatory notifications. The address must be verifiable and registered with the Cámara de Comercio. For purposes of corporate substance and future double tax treaty relief, retention of key personnel and business infrastructure in Colombia is expected.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate unannounced inspection probability; estimated at 15% annually for a standard digital content enterprise, increasing to 30% if the company claims treaty benefits or transacts high volumes of intra-group cross-border licensing.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name reservation and trademark-likelihood search in RUES/SIC
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá / Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff per Cámara de Comercio schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and drafting of S.A.S. articles of incorporation (private deed when allowable)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notary fees per Colombian Notary Tariff

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registration of company with Cámara de Comercio (unique enrollment, legal registry, social security registration)
Sworn Spanish translation of apostilled foreign documents (powers of attorney, passports, corporate certificates)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Certified sworn translator operating in Colombia
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market rate per translated page

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille and consular legalization handling for foreign documents (assumed two to four documents)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the country of origin / Embassy of Colombia

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO preliminary identification and final beneficiary filing with DIAN/Cámara de Comercio
Local corporate attorney due diligence, drafting, and incorporation liaison fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for pre-incorporation services

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Corporate bank account pre-approval and AML client due diligence documentation (optional preliminary)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Bank or digital banking provider (e.g., carrier / correspondent bank compliance fee)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada), arts. 1-51; Código de Comercio, arts. 98-112, 354-356 (registration and officers); Decreto 1074 de 2015 (mercantile registry).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio principal (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (Private Incorporation Deed) registered in the Mercantile Registry (Registro Mercantil)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital; shares may be subscribed with deferred payment terms as stated in bylaws; no escrow account is required for cash contributions in an S.A.S.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: 1) That the company accepts the share subscriptions set forth in the incorporation deed and records the corresponding capital contributions. 2) That the registered office of the company is established at the address designated in the corporate domicile clause. 3) That the following persons are appointed as legal representatives and officers: [Name] as Manager (Representante Legal), [Name] as Secretary, and [Name] as Fiscal Auditor (Revisor Fiscal) if required by law. 4) That the appointed officers are granted the powers and duties provided by law and the bylaws. 5) That the legal representatives are authorized to execute all documents necessary for registry, licensing, and tax registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Prepare and execute the private incorporation deed
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public (if assets contributed require public instrument) or any private party; final registration before the Cámara de Comercio
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the company bylaws (estatutos) in Spanish containing corporate name, domicile, purpose (digital publishing of webtoons), capital structure, share classes, and governance rules. All founding shareholders must sign the document. If real estate or assets requiring public deed are contributed, execute an escritura pública before a notary. The document must include the acceptance of the legal representatives and compliance with AML identification procedures (Sarlaft).
required_dossiers: Private incorporation deed or notarial certificate
Valid identification of each shareholder (cédula / passport)
Certificate of existence and legal representation (pre-registry form)
RUT (Registro Único Tributario) pre-registration if available
Completed registry application form (Formulario de Matrícula Mercantil)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry rejects or queries the documentation, correct the specific deficiencies indicated in the query notice and resubmit within the applicable legal term (generally 10 business days). For substantive defects, execute an amendment to the deed and re-file; pay any associated overdue fees or fines.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain tax registration (RUT) and provisional NIT
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales) – online portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Pre-register the company in the DIAN electronic system using the incorporation document and the S.A.S. bylaws. Obtain the RUT with the assigned NIT (tax identification number). Select the applicable tax regime, economic activities (ISIC 9000), and indicate that the company is a digital content publisher. If the legal representative is appointed, also register their digital signature certificate.
required_dossiers: Incorporation document (certified copy)
Identification of the legal representative
Proof of registered office address (utility bill or lease)
RUT pre-registration form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct any inconsistent NIT or activity codes online in the DIAN RUT update module; if physical verification is required, present original documents at the DIAN service point. Reapply after rectification with proof of submission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Register the company in the Mercantile Registry and obtain the certificate of existence
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio (Chamber of Commerce) – local office with competence over the registered office address
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the executed incorporation deed and required dossiers at the Cámara de Comercio. Pay the registration fee and the applicable contribution tax (impuesto de registro). After review, the Cámara issues the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal, evidencing legal existence and the powers of the legal representative. This certificate is the official proof for banking and licensing.
required_dossiers: Signed private incorporation deed (original and copy)
RUT tax registration or NIT preassignment
Formulario de Matrícula Mercantil
Payment of registration fees and taxes
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Cámara issues a rejection or requires additional information, file a resubmission within the specified term addressing the objections. For formal inconsistencies, submit a corrective amendment to the bylaws or re-execute the incorporation deed. If the fee is miscalculated, pay the revised sum and request the issuance of the certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Register with municipal commercial license (Matrícula de Industria y Comercio)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipal tax authority of the registered domicile (e.g., Secretaría Distrital de Hacienda in Bogotá) via the local online portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the municipal registration for the economic activity code (ISIC 9000 / CIIU 9000) to obtain the Industria y Comercio (ICA) registration. Present the certificate of existence from the Cámara de Comercio. This registration provides the basis for annual ICA tax and municipal territorial taxes. This step is separate from the corporate incorporation but is required for lawful operation.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
RUT with ICA activities registered
Lease or ownership proof of the place of operation
Municipal registration form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct any mismatches between the corporate purpose and the ICA activity code; amend the RUT first if needed. If the municipality imposes a penalty for late registration, pay or request an installment agreement after correcting the registration data.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Hold first shareholder and board meetings adopting corporate governance minutes
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first shareholder meeting and the first board meeting (if separate directors are appointed) to approve the incorporation, ratify the officers, and approve the first board resolution. Execute the minutes in the corporate books and adhere to S.A.S. rules. File with the Cámara de Comercio any appointment of legal representatives not already in the deed. The minutes are internal documents; however, officers' acceptances should be recorded.
required_dossiers: Incorporation deed
Corporate ledger for minutes (Libro de Actas)
Shareholder register (Libro de Accionistas)
Acceptance letters of appointed officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry requires legalization of corporate books, present the books to the Cámara de Comercio for stamping before recording future meetings. In case of invalid appointments, hold a remedial meeting and update the registry.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Information and Communication Technologies (MinTIC) and Cámara de Comercio (for digital content service activity; no industrial manufacturing license required)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable – digital publishing and webtoon syndication do not require an industrial operating license under Colombian law; only a general commercial permit and, if applicable, content registration with MinTIC for online media.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente y Desarrollo Sostenible / ANLA (Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – low-impact digital service activity with no physical industrial discharges; no EIA or registration required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with Ministry Resolution 0631 of 2015 (wastewater discharges) and emissions limits under Resolution 2254 of 2017 (air quality) apply only if an office generates negligible discharges; no site-specific thresholds trigger environmental licensing for pure webtoon publishing.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification for commercial office premises issued by the Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos; structural load inspection certificate (if leasing) or municipal building clearance; basic workplace health and safety compliance under Resolución 0312 de 2019 (minimum occupational health system).

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN); official portal https://www.dian.gov.co; transactional clearance platform MUISCA (https://muisca.dian.gov.co). Electronic invoicing and export declarations (DEX) are processed through DIAN web services/API.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For the local S.A.S.: (1) incorporate as an S.A.S. before the Chamber of Commerce (Cámara de Comercio) using a private incorporation instrument; (2) file the Pre-RUT through DIAN's online portal using the legal representative's digital certificate, entering the CIIU codes for ISIC 9000 creative/artistic activities and related software/publishing sub-activities, and electing the responsible-IVA regime; (3) obtain the definitive RUT with the assigned NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria). The S.A.S. is a Colombian tax resident even at 100% foreign ownership. For a non-resident foreign entity with Colombian-source activity, DIAN issues a foreign-entity NIT after the entity appoints an attorney-in-fact (apoderado) in Colombia and files apostilled constitutional documents, the notarized power of attorney, and foreign tax-residence evidence; this pathway also applies to non-resident digital-service suppliers required to charge Colombian IVA under Law 2155/2021.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation — A Colombian S.A.S. is not pass-through; it is taxed as a corporation on worldwide income at the 35% general corporate rate (Law 2277/2022), with supplementary shareholder dividend withholding (7.5% for resident individuals, 10% for non-residents on profits already taxed at entity level). The S.A.S. is tax-resident because it is incorporated under Colombian law; no territorial election or check-the-box regime exists.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Colombia has no check-the-box or domestic hybrid-entity election; legal-form classification is mandatory. Statutory elections available to the S.A.S. include: (i) the Régimen Simple de Tributación (SIMPLE) for eligible entities with gross receipts no greater than 100,000 UVT (approximately COP 4,706 million in 2024), replacing ordinary income tax, IVA, and consumption tax with a combined cash-based tax; (ii) election of monthly versus bimestrial IVA filing cadence where the taxpayer is an exporter seeking refund efficiency; (iii) the option for non-resident digital sellers to appoint one DIAN-recognized agent for VAT compliance; and (iv) anti-hybrid ordering and deduction-recharacterization rules under ET Articles 129–131 applicable to payments subject to hybrid mismatch treatment.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA (Impuesto al Valor Agregado) — Value Added Tax administered by DIAN; exports of goods and qualifying export services are excluded/zero-rated. A separate Impuesto Nacional al Consumo applies only to designated domestic services and goods and is not relevant to export syndication.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No monetary turnover threshold applies to a Colombian S.A.S.: registration as an IVA-responsible taxpayer is mandatory whenever the company engages in any taxable sale of goods or services, makes imports, or intends to rely on export zero-rating. The simplified IVA privilege (Régimen Simplificado) is available only to natural persons with gross income below 3,500 UVT (approximately COP 164 million in 2024) and is not available to corporations or S.A.S. entities. Non-resident digital-service platforms are subject to mandatory registration from the first sale to a Colombian consumer, without a permanent-establishment threshold, pursuant to Law 2155/2021.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: All IVA-responsible S.A.S. entities must issue electronic invoices (Factura Electrónica de Venta — FEV) through a DIAN-authorized technology provider or DIAN's free billing tool; each FEV is transmitted to DIAN through MUISCA/API and pre-validated in near-real time before dispatch. The invoice must carry the CUFE (Código Único de Facturación Electrónica) and QR code as the functional digital stamp. Purchases from non-invoicing suppliers require the transmission of a Documento Soporte en Adquisiciones. Goods exports require an export declaration (DEX) accepted in MUISCA; service exports are documented through the forex service-settlement form (Form No. 6). Noncompliance triggers penalties under ET Article 652, ranging from 1% of unfactured operations to up to 1,500 UVT per irregular invoice, with establishment-closure powers.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods: any physical export covered by an approved DEX is zero-rated for IVA. Services: the webtoon publishing and syndication service qualifies under ET Article 481 where the service is rendered to a person not domiciled in Colombia and is used or exploited exclusively abroad, or falls within the statutory deemed-export digital services list (software, cloud/digital platform services, licensing of intangibles to non-residents). For the CO_SAS earning Apple IAP and Google Play Billing revenue, zero-rating requires: (i) the contracting counterparty is Apple, Google, or another non-resident platform/end-user; (ii) the licensed webtoon IP is consumed or monetized outside Colombia; (iii) the entity retains geolocation and platform settlement reports supporting foreign consumption; and (iv) proceeds are settled in foreign currency. Any portion of revenue attributed to Colombian domestic consumers constitutes taxable domestic digital services at 19% IVA and must be invoiced accordingly.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DEX / Declaración de Exportación) accepted electronically in MUISCA for goods, and the Declaración de Cambio por Servicios (Form No. 6) for service exports
Transport document for goods — Bill of Lading, Air Waybill, or multimodal/commercial evidence of departure from Colombian customs territory
Inward Remittance Certificate (Certificado de Cambio) issued by an authorized Colombian foreign-exchange intermediary evidencing settlement of export proceeds within the statutory window
Commercial contract, licence agreement, and the FEV electronic invoice identifying the non-resident counterparty and the exclusive foreign use/exploitation of the digital content
Non-residence evidence of the customer, such as a foreign tax-residence certificate, Apple/Google intermediary reporting, and platform settlement statements
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN applies heightened scrutiny to exporters claiming input-VAT refunds: the zero-rating claim must reconcile with the DEX, the FEV set, the FX settlement certificate, and the non-resident-use evidence; the general fiscal-review period is five years from the statutory return due date, with extension where no return is filed. If zero-rating or the refund is disallowed, DIAN claws back 19% VAT on the underlying export value plus monthly moratory interest, and imposes a 160% inaccuracy penalty on the omitted tax (ET Articles 647–648), a 20% surcharge on unjustly obtained refunds (ET Article 651), and invoicing penalties under ET Article 652. Intentional fraud using fictitious foreign buyers, falsified FX declarations, or mischaracterized domestic Apple/Google revenue triggers criminal tax-evasion liability and, for goods, contraband forfeiture sanctions.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (Central Bank of Colombia) is the sole foreign-exchange administration authority, acting through its Board of Directors, the Foreign Exchange Office (Oficina de Cambio) and the normative framework of Resolución Externa No. 1 de 2018 and Circular Reglamentaria DCIN 83. Policy coordination rests with the Ministry of Finance and Public Credit; DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales) enforces tax, customs and anti-money-laundering consequences of FX operations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Colombian peso (COP) is freely convertible under a managed-float regime. Current account transactions, including platform commissions, royalties, technical/creative services and profit remittances, are permitted without quantitative exchange controls but must be channelled through the regulated foreign exchange market (authorized IMCs, compensation accounts or exchange houses). Capital account transactions, notably equity injections by non-resident shareholders of the S.A.S., are permitted without previous authorization but require mandatory registration with Banco de la República via Form 1 within the statutory window. Profit distribution to non-resident shareholders is unrestricted once corporate income tax at 35% is settled; a dividend remittance surtax of up to 10% may apply under Article 245 of the Tax Code on the portion of the distribution not taxed at shareholder level. No special hurdle applies to the digital webtoon syndication business; the ability to remit is a matter of tax clearance rather than exchange authorization.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Colombia does not impose a mandatory conversion (surrender) ratio; however, 100% of export receipts are classified as obligatorily channelled foreign exchange and must be repatriated through the foreign exchange market. For exports of services, including digital webtoon licensing, platform revenues and multilingual chapter-unlocking revenues, the statutory channeling term is six (6) months counted from the date of provision of the service (invoice issuance). Channeling is effected through an IMC or a foreign-currency compensation account (Cuenta de Compensación), and the exporter must present Form 2 (Declaración de Cambio por Exportación de Servicios) within five (5) business days. Exported proceeds may remain in USD in a compensation account without conversion; conversion to COP is at the exporter's discretion. Any failure to channel within the deadline triggers administrative penalties and recharacterization risk; the exporter must document the receivable with the DIAN electronic invoice.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (COP current account plus USD Cuenta de Compensación)
Operational Account (COP) with FX clearing access
Operational Account (COP) with deliverable FX forward onboarding
Capital Escrow Account (temporary holding of investor proceeds before capital registration)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-Medium as a standalone rail. Offshore digital EMIs (e.g., Wise, Airwallex, Payoneer, offshore Neo-banks) are not authorized foreign-exchange market participants in Colombia: they cannot complete Form 1/Form 2 declarations with Banco de la República, cannot issue channeling certificates required by DIAN, and cannot provide the legal audit trail for export proceeds. Use of an EMI is legally viable only as a temporary collection float that is promptly swept to a tier-1 IMC account, with every inflow traceable to the corresponding DIAN electronic invoice. Permanent reliance on an offshore EMI without a domestic IMC account exposes the S.A.S. to FX-control penalties, SARLAFT adverse classification, and potential DIAN assessment of un-repatriated revenue. For the low-risk webtoon trade, a direct tier-1 bank relationship is the recommended clearing path.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Tier-1 Colombian banks generally require an in-person (face-to-face) AML interview of the legal representative or a formally empowered officer of the S.A.S. under SARLAFT (Sistema de Administración del Riesgo de Lavado de Activos y Financiación del Terrorismo) before opening treasury and FX-capable accounts, including USD compensation accounts; the interview validates corporate identity against the Cámara de Comercio Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal and the RUT. Remote onboarding using biometric video verification has been accepted for low-risk resident representatives under the Financial Superintendence norms, but non-resident directors cannot avoid the interview unless a Colombian attorney-in-fact is appointed under an apostilled, notarized power of attorney. A Declaración de Beneficiario Final must disclose every natural person holding 5% or more, and beneficiaries displaying PEP status or residency in higher-risk jurisdictions will trigger extended due diligence.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque non-resident ownership matrix (offshore intermediate shareholders) or beneficial owner located in a higher-risk jurisdiction
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apostilled certificate of good standing of each shareholder and intermediate entity; complete chain-of-title from the S.A.S. up to each natural person; Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales (RUBF) declaration; sworn non-PEP certificate; source-of-wealth and source-of-funds letters for the capital injection.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-frequency micro-collections from Apple IAP and Google Play Billing inconsistent with traditional export invoice flow
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Platform registration certificates, current payout statements from Apple Distribution International and Google Ireland Ltd, monthly subscriber-count analytics, DIAN electronic invoice (factura electrónica) reconciliation, and an export-revenue schedule certified by the fiduciary officer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Outbound royalty/licensing remittances with insufficient evidence of intellectual-property ownership of the webtoon catalogue
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Copyright registration certificates for the webtoon titles; chain-of-title notarized assignments from creators to the S.A.S.; foreign syndication and licensing contracts; DIAN-compliant transfer-pricing documentation for any intercompany royalty; Form 2 channeling declaration for each remittance.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions and PEP screening hits on platform counterparties or in the correspondent clearing chain
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Automated sanctions-screening report with negative results, OFAC/UNSC denylist declaration, territorial license terms excluding sanctioned jurisdictions, customer geolocation controls implemented in the webtoon application, and a trade-compliance commitment letter signed by the legal representative.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Non-resident equity contributions are routed as foreign direct investment and must be verifiable end-to-end. Protocol: (i) the shareholder issues a SWIFT MT103 in USD or EUR to the S.A.S.'s IMC account or USD compensation account in Colombia; Field 70 (Remittance Information) must quote the NIT of the S.A.S., the corporate registration number, and the FX purpose description 'Aporte de capital social - Inversión internacional directa' matching the Banco de la República purpose code for Form 1; (ii) the receiving IMC files Form 1 (Declaración de Inversión Internacional) within three (3) months from the capital augmentation; (iii) the S.A.S. updates the Cámara de Comercio registry and obtains a fresh Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal; (iv) the beneficial-ownership register (RUBF) is updated; and (v) USD may remain in the compensation account or be converted to COP at spot through the IMC. Shareholder loans are declared as external credit (Form 6) and may be subject to reserve/deposit rules if regulated.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound settlements for platform commissions, creative/editorial services, revenue sharing and foreign licensing are executed through SWIFT MT103 or IMC online transfer against a DIAN electronic invoice, with the IMC completing Form 2 for service exports using the DCIN 83 purpose codes for export-of-services revenue and with any applicable withholding tax remitted to DIAN under the royalty/technical-service rules. Apple and Google proceeds arrive mainly as USD remittances from Apple Distribution International or Google Ireland Ltd referencing net subscription proceeds; these inflows are service-export proceeds and must be channelled within the six-month term. Large-value copyright acquisitions or minority licence buy-outs may be documented through a commercial Letter of Credit (documentary credit) adding bank confirmation for the licensor; lower-value contractor payments are more efficiently handled via the IMC's batch-payment module. As the S.A.S.'s treasury matures, a virtual IBAN / multi-currency account at the primary tier-1 bank may be opened to consolidate USD, EUR and GBP receivables for re-invoicing through the Colombian compensation account.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Confirmed deliverable COP/USD forward contracts (FX forwards) entered with an authorized IMC registered with Banco de la República
Vanilla FX options (calls and puts) on COP/USD purchased from authorized foreign-exchange market participants
Cross-currency swaps (USD/COP) covering long-term licensing receivables and debt-service matching

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on COP/USD permissible only for non-resident counterparties or under specific IMC authorization; therefore recommended for the offshore parent rather than for the Colombian tax-resident S.A.S.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil (Annual Commercial Registry Renewal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal: fine of up to 1% of the registered assets per month of delay, subject to statutory caps; failure to renew for two consecutive years results in cancellation of the mercantile registration and administrative strike-off of the company.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Declaración de Renta y Complementarios (Annual Corporate Income Tax Return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Unidad Administrativa Especial – Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually, between 9 August and 14 October for the preceding tax year, according to the last two digits of the NIT
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of 5% of the tax due per month or fraction thereof, capped at 100% of the tax; statutory interest accrues on unpaid amounts; persistent non-compliance may trigger administrative seizure and suspension of the tax payer's Certificate of Residence.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: An S.A.S. must appoint a Revisor Fiscal (statutory auditor) when total assets or gross revenues exceed 3,000 SMLMV (approximately USD 1.0 million in 2024) or when the shareholder count exceeds 30. Below these thresholds, no independent statutory audit is compulsory.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Colombian GAAP under the IFRS for SMEs (NIIF para las PYMES) adopted by Law 1314 of 2009; full IFRS applies only to public interest entities, which a digital webtoon syndication typically is not.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The S.A.S. must annually confirm its ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs) with the DIAN through the RUBF platform. UBOs include natural persons with a direct or indirect ownership of 10% or more of the capital or voting rights, or who otherwise exercise control. The annual confirmation is generally due by 31 May; any shareholding change must be reported within 15 calendar days thereafter. Non-compliance carries fines under Article 651-3 of the Tax Code and may affect tax clearance.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 120 – USD 300 per year for a registered office address service
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not legally required if below audit thresholds; voluntary audit approximately USD 1,000 – USD 2,500
